description: This file defines a 'Loupe' class for image magnification and inspection, including event handling and image processing functions.

classes.name: Loupe
classes.description: A class for magnifying and inspecting image regions with event handling.

methods.name: _handleOutputClick
methods.description: Handles click events on output images to show magnified region.

methods.name: _handleLoupeClick
methods.description: Handles click events on loupe controls to move magnified view.

methods.name: _showFor
methods.description: Displays magnified view for specified coordinates.

methods.name: _fillFromImage
methods.description: Fills magnified view from an image source.

methods.name: _fillFromCanvas
methods.description: Fills magnified view from a canvas source.
